title: e2e harness claim row
description: One recorded claim of the e2e harness (chant#4587), terragucci's protocol: one claim, a plain run that must pass, a BREAK=1 run that must be caught, one row. The row is the claim outcome of a run record on the ledger (op e2e-claim, chant#4551), and a product's page reads the rows rendered as e2e-claims/v1. A row is only written for a run whose no-real-cloud scan said CLEAN. An engine counts a row only when engine.version is the version its claim is about. Version 1: a field is only ever added within contract 1, and a new field is optional.

product.description: The product that drove the scenario.

binary.description: The engine binary the pipeline ran: choudoufu, plunge, tofu, pulumi, yodel, chant.

version.description: Its version as it reported it.

floci.description: The floci image digest the run's stack ran.

chant.description: The chant version the harness ran.

plain.description: The plain run: pass when every outcome held.

break.description: The BREAK run: caught when an outcome did not hold, missed when all held, stalled when a step did not finish.

safeRun.description: The no-real-cloud scan's verdict. Only CLEAN is ever recorded.

runUrl.description: Where the run's logs are, when it ran in CI.
